## Live performance

- Photographer: Bill Ebbesen.
- Subject: Kanye West at Roskilde Festival, July 2, 2009.
- Original resolution: 3,054 × 2,333.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kanye_West_Roskilde_Festival_2009.JPG
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

The website includes responsive WebP encodings at their original aspect ratio, up to the original resolution. Images are resampled and recompressed for efficient delivery; colours and content are retained. CSS crops the display to the existing image frames. No generated imagery is used. Photographer credits, source links, and licence links are displayed under each photograph.
